description: Combine the portable persistent-scratch n512 BF16x9 production path with the residency-safe aligned-factor n2048 cooperative reducer: transplant only unique n2048 deltas onto ee3484bf, reconcile extension scratch, handles, launch attributes, and CUDA-version guards, preserve exact certificates, strict compatibility paths, fallbacks, and all other sizes, then profile both target families and integration overhead.

Three-way integrated fb28d99aa's unique n2048 cooperative resident reducer onto ee3484bf's portable persistent-scratch n512 BF16x9 base. The merge preserves BF16x9 state, version gate, strict fallback, replay scratch and every non-n2048 route while adding the 15-cluster LoadBalancing cooperative launch, residual-corrected WMMA update, omitted third-W writes and scoped aligned float4 fringe reads. Build and kernelguard passed; validation passed 39/39. Full metric is 23034.330732 us, n2048 83268.941 us; n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even are 51541.387/91727.741/89666.133/122832.512/50013.067 us.

Reused the already allocated n2048 eigenvector output as the resident reducer's mutable matrix by copying input into it before launch; inverse iteration overwrites that lifetime after reduction. This removes one recurring 128 MiB batch8 tensor allocation without changing panel factors, launch attributes, reducer arithmetic, certificates or other routes. Build and kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Full metric 23035.921752 us versus combined parent 23034.330732; n2048 improves 83268.941 to 83233.610 us while aggregate is noise-tied.

Added a device-aware grow-only n2048 scratch state for the resident reducer's [batch,2048,24] factor records, independent of the BF16x9 compile guard, on top of the output-buffer matrix alias. Build/kernelguard passed and validation 39/39. N2048 was 83232.107 us versus 83233.610 without persistent factors, effectively neutral; full metric regressed to 23059.122651 from unrelated n512/n1024 movement, so this isolates allocation lifetime without a target-path kernel gain.

Compiled and measured the combined extension with EIGH_DISABLE_BF16X9. This removes Bf16x9State/private cuBLAS replay and exercises the production-strict fallback while retaining the resident cooperative n2048 reducer, persistent n2048 factors, output alias, launch attributes and all bindings. Build/kernelguard passed and validation 39/39. Full metric is 23359.726132 us; n2048 remains 83336.278 us while expected strict n512 costs rise to dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even 54717.686/94755.151/92468.280/122893.044/53116.437 us.

Compiled and measured the combined extension with EIGH_FORCE_BF16X9_COMPAT. BF16x9 replay remains enabled but no optional >=13.5 special-value API identifier is parsed; the cooperative n2048 launch and independent persistent scratch remain intact. Build/kernelguard passed and validation 39/39. Full metric is 23388.755871 us; n2048 remains 83235.641 us. Conservative scan/patch handling raises n512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even to 54822.624/95062.677/92809.428/122871.648/53230.218 us, matching the expected compatibility cost.

Restored the production combined source byte-for-byte to trial 0: portable modern BF16x9 with persistent n512 replay scratch plus the scoped-aligned resident n2048 reducer, removing forced macros, the neutral persistent n2048 factors and output alias. Fresh build/kernelguard passed and validation 39/39. Replay full metric is 23054.081421 us, moved by noisy n1024 mixed sampling; n2048 is 83294.586 us. Trial 0 remains the identical-source best at 23034.330732/83268.941 us with both SHA-named target profiles.

Completed six measured integration trials. Terminal e686127658e5677140ad3696ef9916adf75098eb is byte-identical to combined trial0 5929ff732 and preserves ee3484bf's portable scan-free BF16x9 state, persistent two-buffer n512 replay scratch, certificates, strict fallback and every route while transplanting fb28d99aa's residency-safe 15-cluster LoadBalancing n2048 reducer, corrected WMMA update, omitted third-W stores and scoped aligned float4 fringe reads. Best full metric was 23034.330732 us; terminal replay 23054.081421 moved with noisy n1024 mixed sampling. N2048 measured 83268.941 us initially and 83294.586 us on replay; final nsys reducer is 63.951 ms average, 77.0% GPU time, with no repair kernels. N512 dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/dense-even were 51541.387/91727.741/89666.133/122832.512/50013.067 us, and separate SHA-named n512/n2048 profiles are saved. Output-buffer matrix alias removed 128 MiB and reached 83233.610 us but aggregate 23035.921752; grow-only n2048 factors were target-neutral at 83232.107 us and aggregate 23059.122651. Strict EIGH_DISABLE_BF16X9 compiled, passed 39/39 and measured 23359.726132; forced older-header compatibility compiled, passed 39/39 and measured 23388.755871, with n2048 unchanged in both. All production and fallback builds were kernelguard-clean and all validations passed 39/39. Keep the search moving: one-time device-scoped function-attribute configuration, lifetime aliasing factors into output storage with explicit packed pitch, occupancy-derived portable cluster counts, and remote evaluator verification of the combined CUDA-header path remain concrete follow-ups. No leaderboard submission was made by this worker, and no account leaderboard score is attributed to it.
